summary:
REVIEWED: the builder's work holds up, with four defects fixed in place.

The pk3 and QVM are unchanged by the review and were rebuilt byte-identical twice:
- baseq3/zz-fleetres-ui.pk3: 283,708 B, md5 f737a9d51ed89c22d6b2be31cf8368d3, one STORED member vm/ui.qvm.
- vm/ui.qvm: 283,592 B, md5 b764efe7d8856bc5191e5df3b4349289, VM_MAGIC 0x12721444, 32-byte header, no jump table, same 1 MiB VM memory as pak8.
- It is id's q3_ui from the GPL release (dbe4ddb), built with ioq3's q3lcc and q3asm -vq3 (83a77628). Only ui_video.c changes.

What the menu does:
- The Video Mode list is r_availableModes on ioquake3 and id's 12 modes on retail 1.32c.
- The running r_mode -1 size (1920x1080 on the LCDs) is always listed and selected.
- ACCEPT on that entry writes back r_mode -1 1920x1080. Stock pak8 showed 640x480 and ACCEPT wrote r_mode 3.

Independently re-verified:
- Every staged original md5/size, all 17 pak8 vm/ui.qvm string offsets and bytes, and the engine offsets.
- The stock build equals my own pak8 extract byte for byte.
- 42 of 43 compiled units are textually identical. Inside ui_video.asm, the functions the patch does not touch are identical.
- A relocation-aware byte diff against pak8's own QVM: 0 unexplained operands in 77,445 instructions and 2,831 data words outside ui_video. The literal pool differs only inside ui_video's strings.
- The pk3's zip headers are sound for id's unzip.
- Graphics Settings presets and the Voodoo mode clamp behave exactly as in id's code.

Fixed:
1. pk3_order_key used name.lower(). Both engines sort pk3s with FS_PathCmp, which UPPER-cases, so the "nothing shadows our pk3" check passed names like zz-fleetres-u_.pk3 that the engines would load first. It now mirrors FS_PathCmp, and a new test compiles id's own FS_PathCmp to check it.
2. --publish could overwrite an existing backup. It never does now.
3. --install-server only checked that the library had the pk3. It now also reads retro-autodeploy's per-box records and refuses while any box has not synced since the publish. Without the pk3, a box is dropped by the pure server.
4. The hardware plan had a false-pass trap. On a box already at Trilinear, RIGHT on Texture Filter only buzzes and ACCEPT never appears. And a "...setting mode -1" line is printed by the launch itself, so it proved nothing. The plan now chooses the key direction and requires the mode line to appear after an echoed marker.

Tests: 42 passed. Nothing was written to the share, a box or the server.
files_created: /home/voidsstr/development/retro-agent/.claude/worktrees/lcd1080-patches/provisioning/patches/q3-baseq3-ui/apply.py (builder's; REVIEW-MODIFIED: FS_PathCmp sort key, backup never overwritten, install-server fleet-readiness gate, publish next-steps, --force help)

/home/voidsstr/development/retro-agent/.claude/worktrees/lcd1080-patches/tests/python/test_patch_q3-baseq3-ui.py (builder's; REVIEW-MODIFIED: +5 tests, install-server test uses a fake autodeploy state)
/home/voidsstr/.retro-fleet/patch-out/q3-baseq3-ui/ (outside git; rebuilt by the reviewer - pk3/QVM byte-identical to the builder's, manifest and source/apply.py refreshed)
launcher_changes_needed: NONE is required for this fix, confirmed by review. Both engines load vm/ui.qvm from zz-fleetres-ui.pk3 automatically: vm_ui defaults to 2, and the name sorts after pak8.pk3 under FS_PathCmp. No change is needed to Play Quake III Arena.bat, Play Quake III Arena - retail 1.32c.bat, Play Team Arena.bat, FLEETGL.BAT, stage-fleetres.py, gameres.h or fleetres.c.

No FLEETRES-vs-GAMERES conflict. This patch writes no cfg at all. The menu simply displays the r_mode -1 + r_customwidth/r_customheight that the launcher (command line and baseq3\fleetres.cfg) and gameres.h already write. Nothing generated carries a parenthesis: zz-fleetres-ui.pk3, zz-fleetres-ui-source/ and originals-2026-09-29/.

Coordination (kept from the builder, agreed): the ioquake3 lane's proposed '+set vm_ui 0 +set sv_pure 0' via FR_UIARGS is redundant with this pk3 and should not ship. This QVM serves ioquake3 AND retail: at the main menu, in sv_pure-1 local games, and on the fleet server once --install-server has run. If it ships anyway, the two coexist. uix86.dll runs at the menu and in sv_pure-0 games; the QVM runs on pure servers. The Team Arena vm_ui leak the verifier found then applies.

Withdrawal only, if the pk3 is ever retired (kept from the builder). GAMESYNC never deletes, so stage-fleetres.py must add `if exist "%~dp0baseq3\zz-fleetres-ui.pk3" del /f /q "%~dp0baseq3\zz-fleetres-ui.pk3"` before the start line of both baseq3 launchers. Remove the pk3 from quake3-server's baseq3 and restart the server FIRST, or every client that deleted it is dropped as unpure.

Publish-phase step, not a launcher edit: after --publish, change the one line of \\192.168.1.122\files\Files\Games-Library\_deploy_generation.txt. Do this ONCE, after all of the night's patches are published, because the file is shared by every title. retro-autodeploy then runs GAMESYNC RESET + START on each box as it comes online, including the boxes that are off now. Without it, a provisioned box never fetches the new pk3.

OPTIONAL hardening for a pre-existing hazard. It is not caused by and not needed for this patch; no LCD box has 3dfxvgl.dll. In the share-only \\192.168.1.122\files\Files\Games-Library\Quake3-TeamArena\FLEETGL.BAT, directly after the line `:toobig`, insert with CRLF like the rest of the file: `>>%1 echo seta r_glDriver "opengl32"`. It is guarded by tests/python/test_q3_voodoo2_gl.py. Why: pak8's ACCEPT writes the Linux name r_glDriver "libGL.so.1", and this patch keeps that. When retail GLW_StartOpenGL cannot load it, it tries 3dfxvgl BEFORE opengl32 and archives whichever succeeds. On a box with system32\3dfxvgl.dll whose panel is over 800x600, one retail ACCEPT would pin the Voodoo MiniGL at the panel size for every later retail launch.
server_installs: /home/voidsstr/q3a-server/.q3a/baseq3/zz-fleetres-ui.pk3 (md5 f737a9d51ed89c22d6b2be31cf8368d3, 283,708 B). Install with `python3 provisioning/patches/q3-baseq3-ui/apply.py --install-server`, then run `systemctl --user restart quake3-server`. That directory is quake3-server's fs_homepath baseq3: the journal lists pak8..pak0 there, and /usr/lib/ioquake3/baseq3 holds only qagame.so. NOT RUN.

GATES, as changed by the review. It refuses unless (a) the library carries the same md5 AND (b) every retro-autodeploy record in ~/.retro-fleet/autodeploy.json shows a completed sync after the pk3 reached the share. It prints the per-box table either way. A box autodeploy never reached, or a legacy address-keyed record, reads as NOT ready. The live table today would list the stale legacy .133/.143/.171/.246 records. Read the list, then use --force only for boxes that do not carry Quake3-TeamArena.

Why the gate matters: the server is ioq3 1.36+u20251228. When pure, its SV_SpawnServer TOUCHES vm/ui.qvm (ioq3 since 2018, commit 4fa93fbf). Once installed, the pk3 becomes both the UI checksum every client must match and a referenced, downloadable pak. A client without it gets 'Unpure Client. You may need to enable in-game downloads ... (set cl_allowDownload 1)'. Fleet boxes leave cl_allowDownload at 0.

Other consequences: ioq3ded also re-reads its pk3s at every map change (SV_SpawnServer calls FS_Restart), so the copy is atomic (.tmp then rename). Verify with `journalctl --user -u quake3-server -n 80 | grep -i zz-fleetres-ui.pk3`. Roll back with `rm` of the file, then `systemctl --user restart quake3-server`. q3ta-server (missionpack, sv_pure 0) needs nothing.
tests:
`python3 -m pytest -q tests/python/test_patch_q3-baseq3-ui.py` (worktree lcd1080-patches): 42 passed in about 0.8 s, 0 skipped with the cache, build and share present. The builder had 37.

Added by the review:
- test_pk3_order_is_fs_pathcmp_not_a_lower_case_compare: asserts both the new key and that the OLD lower() key mis-ordered zz-fleetres-u_.pk3 and zz-^.pk3.
- test_pk3_order_key_matches_the_engines_own_fs_pathcmp: compiles FS_PathCmp out of id's pinned files.c and lets it qsort. Skips loudly without the cache. Mutation-checked: the old key fails it.
- test_install_server_refuses_while_a_box_has_not_synced_since_the_publish.
- test_fleet_readiness_reads_autodeploy_records: covers a superseded legacy record, an un-rekeyed legacy record, and an unparseable time.
- test_publish_never_overwrites_a_backup.
- test_install_server_refuses_before_the_library_has_the_pk3 now uses a FAKE autodeploy state; it would otherwise have read the real fleet records.

Skip-loudly behaviour confirmed with HOME redirected: 3 tests skipped with 'SKIPPED LOUDLY ... NOT checked'.

Other review checks, run independently (evidence in .claude/evidence-1080p/build-q3-baseq3-ui/review-*):
- `apply.py --check`: exit 0.
- `apply.py --build`, run twice (scratch, then the default OUTDIR): exit 0 both times, all 4 gates, pk3 f737a9d5... and QVM b764efe7... identical to the builder's.
- An originals re-read with my own code.
- An asm-level drift diff: 42 of 43 units identical; untouched ui_video functions identical.
- A relocation-aware byte diff against pak8's QVM: 0 unexplained.
- Fixed-count keystroke replay in qvmsim of the hardware plan: counts correct, Trilinear trap reproduced 4/4.
- Presets and the Voodoo clamp: identical to id's code.
- Server version and source check.

--publish and --install-server were NOT run, not even as --dry-run.
risks: PURE-SERVER ORDERING. After --install-server, any client without the pk3 is dropped with 'Unpure Client ... set cl_allowDownload 1'. This server's ioq3ded touches vm/ui.qvm, so the pk3 is offered for download, but only to clients with cl_allowDownload 1; the fleet leaves it at 0. --install-server now refuses until retro-autodeploy records a post-publish sync of every box. A box outside autodeploy, a GAMESYNC run only by hand, or a non-library install is still on the operator. Examples: timedemo_sweep's C:\Quake III Arena\Quake3 on .124, or a player's own PC.

scripts/benchmarks/lan_check.py joins 192.168.1.132:27961 from C:\Games\Quake3-TeamArena. After --install-server it fails on any box that has not synced. That is a correct, visible failure, not a regression.

Until --install-server, matches on :27961 show pak8's stock menu (640x480, and ACCEPT writes r_mode 3); this is source-confirmed. After a pure match that UI stays loaded at the main menu until the next vid_restart or map load. Do not ACCEPT inside such a match.

GAMESYNC on a provisioned box idles until RESET + START. Bump _deploy_generation.txt once after all publishes so retro-autodeploy re-syncs boxes as they come online. GAMESYNC never deletes, so withdrawing the pk3 needs a del line, and the server copy must go first.

Kept pak8 heritage: ACCEPT writes r_glDriver 'libGL.so.1', or 'libMesaVoodooGL.so' when the Voodoo driver is selected; the builder kept this for 'nothing but the video mode changes'. ioquake3 1.36 has no r_glDriver at all (0 hits case-insensitive), so it is ignored there. Retail falls back to 3dfxvgl, then opengl32. None of the four LCD boxes has 3dfxvgl.dll (FLEETGL keeps them on ioquake3; .145 is measured), so the fallback lands on opengl32. Only a box with a stray system32\3dfxvgl.dll and a panel over 800x600 is exposed, and it is equally exposed with stock pak8. The optional FLEETGL line in launcher_changes_needed closes it.

The pk3 replaces the whole baseq3 UI for both engines: menus, the server browser and favourites server1..16, the CD-key menu. Mitigations: byte-identical reproduction of pak8; 42/43 compiled units textually identical; a relocation-aware byte diff with 0 unexplained differences; the behaviour gate; presets and the Voodoo clamp exercised by the review. It has not yet run on a real engine; the hardware plan is the proof.

Shadowing: any pk3 in ioquake3's homepath baseq3 (%APPDATA%\Quake3\baseq3) that carries vm/ui.qvm is searched before every basepath pk3, whatever its name. So is a loose %APPDATA%\Quake3\baseq3\vm\ui.qvm, when the game is not pure. In the library, any baseq3 pk3 sorting after 'zz-fleetres-ui.pk3' under FS_PathCmp would shadow it; --check tests exactly that now. Mods that ship their own ui.qvm (defrag) keep it. unlagged and instaunlagged use ours.

Unchanged id behaviour: the Graphics Settings presets set id's sizes (High Quality = 800x600, Fast = 512x384), and 1920x1080 shows as 'Custom'. An in-game choice other than the panel size lasts only for the session, because FLEETRES/GAMERES reapply r_mode -1 + panel size at every launch.
UX: on retail, 1920x1080 is the LAST entry (13 of 13), so RIGHT buzzes and LEFT walks id's table. On ioquake3 it is FIRST (driver order), so LEFT buzzes.

Hardware-plan trap, now fixed in the plan: on a box already at Trilinear, RIGHT on Texture Filter only buzzes and ACCEPT stays hidden. The plan's DOWN x3 then lands on GRAPHICS and RETURN applies nothing, so the check would pass without any vid_restart. Measured in qvmsim 4/4.
The behaviour gate and my replays run in qvmsim, a software model with a stub engine. They prove the QVM's logic and the menu paths, not the renderers or the JIT.
hw_verification_plan:
PRE (host, publish phase)
1. `python3 provisioning/patches/q3-baseq3-ui/apply.py --check` must exit 0.
2. `apply.py --build` must print 4 GATE lines, pk3 md5 f737a9d51ed89c22d6b2be31cf8368d3 (283708 B) and QVM md5 b764efe7d8856bc5191e5df3b4349289.
3. `apply.py --publish`: sources first, pk3 last, each verified through /mnt. Then run `python3 scripts/validate-staged-library.py --quiet`.
4. Carry it to the boxes. After ALL of the night's publishes, change the one line of Files/Games-Library/_deploy_generation.txt ONCE; retro-autodeploy then runs GAMESYNC RESET+START on each box as it comes online. For a quick test box, run GAMESYNC RESET + START by hand.
5. On each box require all three: `GAMESYNC STATUS` shows state=done AND failed_files 0 AND titles_done == titles_total; and `DIRLIST <GamesDir>\Quake3-TeamArena\baseq3` lists zz-fleetres-ui.pk3 at 283708 B. GamesDir is C:\Games unless HKLM\Software\RetroAgent\GamesDir is set.
6. Do NOT run --install-server yet.

BOX PREP (order: .145 XP, then .123, .240 XP, then .195 Win7)
- PROCLIST and WINLIST first; other agents share these boxes.
- DOWNLOAD both q3config.cfg as backups: %APPDATA%\Quake3\baseq3\ (ioquake3) and <GamesDir>\Quake3-TeamArena\baseq3\ (retail).
- DIRLIST %APPDATA%\Quake3\baseq3 for stray *.pk3 or a vm\ folder; either shadows ours.
- UPLOAD into <GamesDir>\Quake3-TeamArena\baseq3:
  - zzmark.cfg = `echo zzmark before accept`
  - zzchk.cfg = `path` and `condump zzchk.txt`
  Names are lowercase with no underscores, because UIKEY TEXT loses SHIFT under ioquake3.

A) ioquake3 1.36
1. `EXEC cmd /c start "" /D "<GamesDir>\Quake3-TeamArena" "Play Quake III Arena.bat"`. WINLIST must show SDL_app 'ioquake3' at 1920x1080.
2. UIKEY TILDE, `UIKEY TEXT:exec zzmark`, RETURN, TILDE. This puts a marker in the console BEFORE any ACCEPT.
3. Navigate (keyboard reaches this menu fullscreen; counts replayed with fixed presses on the built QVM, review-05): DOWN x2 (SETUP), RETURN, DOWN x2 (SYSTEM), RETURN, DOWN x7 (focus on Video Mode).
4. SCREENSHOT 0 (GDI works fullscreen on XP): must read 'Video Mode: 1920x1080' (stock: 640x480) and 'Graphics Settings: Custom'.
5. RIGHT shows the next driver mode (e.g. 1680x1050); take a SCREENSHOT. LEFT returns to 1920x1080; LEFT again only buzzes.
6. DOWN x7 to Texture Filter, then SCREENSHOT. If it reads Bilinear press RIGHT; if Trilinear press LEFT. RIGHT on Trilinear only buzzes, ACCEPT never appears, and the next steps would apply NOTHING.
7. SCREENSHOT: the ACCEPT button must be visible bottom-right. Then DOWN x3 (Driver Info, BACK, ACCEPT), RETURN.
8. WINLIST must still show 1920x1080, not 640x480.
9. TILDE, `exec zzchk`, RETURN, TILDE. DOWNLOAD %APPDATA%\Quake3\baseq3\zzchk.txt. It must contain:
   - AFTER the 'zzmark before accept' line, a '...setting mode -1: 1920 1080' line. The launch's own line is before the marker, so this one proves ACCEPT ran vid_restart and kept the mode.
   - In `path`, ...\baseq3\zz-fleetres-ui.pk3 (1 files) listed above pak8.pk3.

B) Retail 1.32c
1. Quit ioquake3. If you kill it, use `taskkill /f /im "ioquake3.x86.exe"` with the quotes.
2. `EXEC cmd /c start "" /D "<GamesDir>\Quake3-TeamArena" "Play Quake III Arena - retail 1.32c.bat"`. WINLIST must show 'Quake 3: Arena' at 1920x1080.
3. exec zzmark, then the same keys. Video Mode must read '1920x1080' as entry 13 of 13: RIGHT buzzes, LEFT gives '856x480 wide screen', RIGHT returns to 1920x1080.
4. Texture Filter rule and ACCEPT as in A, then exec zzchk. DOWNLOAD <GamesDir>\Quake3-TeamArena\baseq3\zzchk.txt. After the marker it must show '...setting mode -1: 1920 1080 FS' / 'MODE: -1, 1920 x 1080 fullscreen'.
5. Also record the GL-driver lines after the marker. This is pak8 heritage: 'libGL.so.1' is expected to fail and fall back to opengl32. `gfxinfo` GL_RENDERER must still be the box's own card.

C) .195 (Win7)
Identical steps, but GDI cannot photograph exclusive fullscreen there. Use UIKEY F11 (or console `screenshotjpeg`) and DOWNLOAD from %APPDATA%\Quake3\baseq3\screenshots (ioquake3) or <GamesDir>\Quake3-TeamArena\baseq3\screenshots (retail).

D) Local pure game, both engines
Console `map q3dm17`, then ESC > SETUP > SYSTEM (navigate by screenshot). Video Mode must read 1920x1080. zzchk must show zz-fleetres-ui.pk3 'on the pure list', because a local sv_pure-1 server lists it.

E) Fleet server BEFORE --install-server, both engines
Console `connect 192.168.1.132:27961`.
- It must join with no drop.
- zzchk must show zz-fleetres-ui.pk3 'not on the pure list'.
- In the match, SETUP > SYSTEM shows the STOCK 640x480 menu, as expected. Do not ACCEPT there.

F) Install on the server
Only when `apply.py --install-server` stops refusing: it prints every retro-autodeploy box, and each must have synced after the pk3 reached the share. Then:
1. `systemctl --user restart quake3-server`.
2. `journalctl --user -u quake3-server -n 80 | grep -i zz-fleetres-ui.pk3` must show the pk3 in the server's search path.

G) Fleet server AFTER, ioquake3 on one box and retail on another, in one match
- Both join; the server journal has no 'Unpure Client'.
- zzchk shows 'on the pure list'.
- In the match, SETUP > SYSTEM > Video Mode reads 1920x1080, and ACCEPT keeps it (marker rule).
- Keep screenshots of BOTH boxes in the match.

MUST NOT CHANGE
- Joining :27961 from both engines, before and after F. After F, a box without the pk3 is refused; that is expected and the gate is meant to prevent it.
- scripts/benchmarks/lan_check.py still passes on synced boxes.
- MULTIPLAYER > Favorites still lists the managed server1..16 entries.
- SETUP > CD Key shows the staged key, and the game starts with no key prompt.
- Play Team Arena.bat still gets missionpack/pak3's Team Arena UI.
- A Voodoo box's retail path still starts; the QVM is original VM_MAGIC.
- On a CRT at r_mode -1 1024x768, Video Mode shows id's 1024x768 entry and an untouched ACCEPT keeps r_mode -1.

CLEANUP
Delete zzmark.cfg, zzchk.cfg, zzchk.txt and the test screenshots. Restore both q3config.cfg backups, since the test changed Texture Filter. Leave each box at its desktop mode.
review_notes:
VERIFIED, independently of the builder's tools. Evidence is in .claude/evidence-1080p/build-q3-baseq3-ui/review-*.

1. Originals, read with my own code through /mnt:
   - pak8.pk3: 454478 B, md5 d8b96d42.
   - Its vm/ui.qvm: 278308 B, md5 3e6b8fad, CRC 9e5dd0a3; header as recorded; all 17 strings at the claimed offsets, NUL-delimited, inside the lit segment.
   - quake3.exe (b5cf3dd5) and ioquake3.x86.exe (12f99bc0): every claimed offset matches.
   - r_availableModes: 0 hits in retail and 1 in ioquake3. r_glDriver: 0 hits in ioquake3 (ignored there). All searches were case-insensitive.
   - The survey's 0xb281e reads 'zD'; the real 'Q3 1.32c' is at 0xb2820, as the builder said.
2. Build: rebuilt twice, pk3 f737a9d5 and QVM b764efe7 both times. The stock build equals my own pak8 extract byte for byte.
3. Drift, beyond the builder's gate:
   - 42 of 43 .asm units are textually identical.
   - Inside ui_video.asm, the 10 functions the patch does not touch are identical (labels normalized, strings compared by content). The 5 edited id functions differ only by the edits: s_fr+1092 = names, s_fr+1824 = current.
   - bss grows by exactly sizeof(frModeList_t) = 1840 B. Memory still rounds to 1 MiB.
   - A relocation-aware byte diff against pak8's own QVM finds 0 unexplained differences in 77,445 instructions and 2,831 data words outside ui_video. The literal pool changes only inside ui_video's strings (+48 B).
4. Behaviour: I replayed the plan's FIXED key counts on both builds in qvmsim. The counts are right, but I found the Trilinear trap below. Presets and the Voodoo clamp behave identically to id's code.
5. pk3 format: STORED, no data descriptor, CRC OK, one member. Sound for id's unzip.
6. Pure-server claims, checked in the id, ioq3-2009 and ioq3-HEAD sources:
   - Kicks: no kick while the server lacks the pk3.
   - Downloadability: the fleet's ioq3ded 1.36+u20251228 touches vm/ui.qvm, so the builder's 'cl_allowDownload 1' statement is RIGHT for this server. It would be wrong for id's 1.32 server, which touches only cgame.
   - Rescan: FS_Restart at every map load is confirmed.
7. Nothing on the share, a box or the server. No game data or binaries under git; __pycache__ is gitignored.

CHANGED, in provisioning/patches/q3-baseq3-ui/apply.py and tests/python/test_patch_q3-baseq3-ui.py only:
(a) pk3_order_key was name.lower(), with a docstring claiming id uses Q_stricmp. Both engines' paksort is FS_PathCmp, which UPPER-cases letters, maps \ and : to /, and compares signed chars. Under lower(), [ \ ] ^ _ ` sort the wrong way, so --check would pass a zz-fleetres-u_.pk3 that the engines load over ours. It now mirrors FS_PathCmp exactly. A new test compiles id's own FS_PathCmp and compares; it was mutation-checked against the old key.
(b) --publish could overwrite an existing backup on a second replace. It now never does: a later replaced copy goes to <backup>.<md5[:8]>.
(c) --install-server gained a fleet-readiness gate, fleet_readiness(), which reads ~/.retro-fleet/autodeploy.json. Unknown counts as NOT ready, and --force overrides after the per-box list is printed. The existing test was changed to a FAKE state file; it would otherwise have read the real fleet records.
(d) --publish's next steps now name _deploy_generation.txt / retro-autodeploy as the way a published file reaches boxes that are off.
(e) The hardware plan: Texture Filter RIGHT-vs-LEFT, a screenshot of ACCEPT before RETURN, and an echoed marker so the '...setting mode' line proves the vid_restart. Plus the lan_check.py and non-library-install consequences.

Rebuilt the default OUTDIR: pk3 and QVM unchanged, source/apply.py now a33fb369 (60470 B).

NOT CHANGED, deliberately:
- The pak8 r_glDriver names: the brief says 'byte-for-byte id behaviour'. It is harmless on the four LCDs; the optional FLEETGL line is listed.
- qvmsim.py, ui_fleetres.h and the patch file, which are correct as written.

FINDINGS.md candidates (not written; this phase forbids it). All are verified; the builder's six still stand.
- Q3 pk3 load order is FS_PathCmp (upper-case), not lower-case.
- ioq3ded since 2018 (4fa93fbf) touches vm/ui.qvm when pure, so a UI-only pk3 on a pure server is downloadable. id 1.32's server touches only cgame.
- q3asm -m maps carry no $N local labels (string literals, function statics), so a binary diff must map the literal pool by its unchanged prefix and suffix.
